effect: Your hair changes to a vivid, unnatural color of the DM's choice.
For the next minute, you can only speak in rhyming couplets. You understand language normally.
A shower of harmless, glowing butterflies erupts from your hands and disperses after 6 seconds.
Your skin turns a faint shade of blue for the next 10 minutes. It has no mechanical effect.
A strong scent of fresh-baked bread fills a 30-foot radius around you for 1 minute.
Your voice drops two octaves for the next minute. You sound like you gargled gravel for breakfast.
Small, harmless flowers sprout from any surface you touch for the next minute.
You hiccup once, and a tiny puff of colorful smoke escapes your mouth. Nothing else happens.
Your eyes glow faintly like embers for the next hour. This sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius.
A spectral kitten appears on your shoulder for 1 minute. It purrs loudly, then vanishes.
Your footsteps produce tiny musical notes (visible, not audible) for the next 10 minutes.
You become aware of the exact number of copper coins within 60 feet of you. The knowledge fades after 1 round.
Your shadow moves independently of you for the next minute, mimicking gestures you made an hour ago.
A single illusory firework explodes 20 feet above your head. It is loud and bright but deals no damage.
Your fingernails turn to polished gold for 1 hour. They are cosmetic only and cannot be sold.
You sneeze, and a small, non-magical gemstone (worth 1 gp) flies out of your nose.
For the next minute, an echo repeats the last word of every sentence you speak.
A faint, ethereal crown of starlight appears above your head for 10 minutes. It has no mechanical effect.
Your clothing changes color to match your surroundings for 1 minute, like a chameleon. It provides no stealth benefit.
A gentle warm breeze swirls around you for 1 round, ruffling papers and cloaks within 10 feet.
You gain the ability to perfectly mimic any animal sound you have heard before. This lasts for 1 hour.
Faint arcane runes appear on your forearms, glowing softly. They are illegible and fade after 10 minutes.
Your next yawn (within 1 hour) produces a tiny, harmless lightning bolt that arcs between your teeth.
A phantom drumroll plays from nowhere for exactly 3 seconds. Everyone within 30 feet hears it.
You taste copper in your mouth for 1 minute. Your tongue tingles slightly. No other effect.
You teleport up to 10 feet in a random direction. If the destination is occupied, you do not teleport.
You gain resistance to fire damage for the next minute.
A fog cloud (as the spell) appears centered on you and lasts for 1 minute. You do not need to concentrate.
You regain 1d4 hit points immediately.
You grow 1d6 inches taller for the next 10 minutes, then return to normal height.
The next weapon attack made against you within 1 minute has disadvantage.
You can see invisible creatures and objects for the next round.
A shield of translucent energy appears around you. You gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
You levitate 1 foot off the ground for 1 minute. Your movement speed is halved while levitating.
Each creature within 10 feet of you takes 1d4 thunder damage as a shockwave ripples outward.
You gain darkvision (60 ft) for the next hour. If you already have darkvision, its range extends by 30 feet.
A small illusory double of you appears and mimics your movements for 1 minute. It cannot interact with anything.
You become immune to the frightened condition for the next 10 minutes.
Your walking speed increases by 10 feet for the next minute.
The nearest unlocked door within 60 feet slams open (or shut, if already open).
You cast Detect Magic without expending a spell slot. You do not need to concentrate on it.
One random creature within 30 feet of you (DM's choice) regains 1d8 hit points.
You gain proficiency in one tool or skill of the DM's choice for the next hour.
Gravity reverses for you for 1 round. You fall upward 10 feet, then gravity returns to normal.
Your next melee attack within 1 minute deals an extra 1d6 force damage.
All nonmagical flames within 30 feet of you are extinguished instantly.
You sprout ethereal antlers made of moonlight. They shed bright light in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute.
You gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. They last for 1 hour.
The ground within 10 feet of you becomes difficult terrain (covered in frost) for 1 minute.
You learn the surface thoughts of one creature within 30 feet (as if you cast Detect Thoughts). This lasts 1 round.
Your weapon (or the nearest weapon within 5 feet) begins to hum and glow faintly for 1 minute, shedding dim light in a 5-foot radius.
A spectral hand appears and drops a random mundane object (rope, torch, rations) at your feet, then vanishes.
You gain resistance to cold damage for the next minute.
You shrink 1d6 inches for the next 10 minutes, then return to normal size.
One random creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom save or be unable to speak for 1 round.
A burst of wild energy heals you for 2d4 hit points but also pushes you 5 feet in a random direction.
You become translucent for 1 round. You gain advantage on Stealth checks but can still be seen.
A static charge builds on your body. The next creature that touches you takes 1d6 lightning damage.
You can read all written languages for the next 10 minutes.
A phantom wind howls through the area. Every creature within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Strength save or be pushed 5 feet away from you.
You cast Fireball centered on yourself at 3rd level. You and all creatures within 20 feet must make the saving throw.
You are polymorphed into a sheep for 1 minute. You retain your mental ability scores but cannot cast spells.
You teleport up to 60 feet to a random unoccupied space. The DM chooses the destination.
A spectral beast (use the statistics of a wolf) appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet. It is hostile to all creatures and disappears after 1 minute.
You and each creature within 20 feet become invisible for 1 round. Attacking or casting a spell ends the invisibility for that creature.
You age 1d10 years. This can be reversed by a Greater Restoration spell.
Gravity reverses in a 20-foot radius around you for 1 round. All creatures and loose objects in the area fall upward 10 feet.
You emit a blinding flash. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or be blinded until the end of their next turn.
Your spell slot of the highest level you have remaining is consumed. If you have no spell slots, you take 2d6 psychic damage instead.
A 10-foot-radius pit (10 feet deep) opens beneath your feet. You and any creatures standing on the spot must make a DC 12 Dexterity save or fall in.
You cast Confusion (as the spell, DC 13) centered on yourself. You are also affected. Concentration is not required.
Your maximum hit points are reduced by 1d10 until your next long rest. This cannot reduce your maximum below 1.
You regain all expended sorcery points. If you have no sorcery points, you regain one 1st-level spell slot instead.
Each creature within 15 feet must make a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, they are restrained by conjured vines until the end of their next turn.
You cast Lightning Bolt in a random direction (DM determines the line). It uses your spell save DC.
You become ethereal for 1 round. You cannot affect or be affected by the material plane. At the end of the round, you return to the nearest unoccupied space.
A wave of healing energy surges outward. Every creature within 30 feet regains 2d6 hit points.
You are launched 30 feet straight up into the air. Normal falling rules apply.
Your body becomes living flame for 1 round. You are immune to fire damage, and any creature that touches you or hits you with a melee attack takes 2d6 fire damage.
A zone of silence (as the Silence spell) appears centered on you for 1 minute. No concentration required.
Your next spell within 1 minute is cast as if using a slot one level higher than the one you spend.
All metal objects within 10 feet of you become red hot for 1 round. Creatures holding metal objects take 1d8 fire damage.
You summon a Tidal Wave (as the spell) originating from your position in a direction of the DM's choice.
Your body crackles with static. For the next minute, any spell you cast that deals damage deals an extra 1d4 lightning damage.
You swap positions with a random creature within 30 feet (DM's choice). Neither creature is harmed by the swap.
You cast Fireball at 5th level centered on yourself. Every creature within 20 feet (including you) must make the saving throw.
You are petrified until the end of your next turn. You are unconscious and turned to stone. Greater Restoration ends this early.
An antimagic field (10-foot radius) surrounds you for 1 minute. All magic within the field is suppressed.
You are teleported to a random plane of existence. You return to your original location after 1 minute. (DM determines the plane.)
Every creature within 30 feet (including you) takes 4d6 force damage. No saving throw.
You lose the ability to cast spells until the end of your next long rest. Cantrips still function.
A hostile elemental (DM's choice of type, CR equal to half your level, minimum 1) appears within 10 feet and attacks the nearest creature.
Your wild magic becomes contagious. The next creature that touches you must roll on this table. Until triggered.
You de-age 2d10 years. If this would reduce your age below 1, you become an infant with no ability to cast spells. Greater Restoration reverses this.
All of your non-magical equipment is teleported to a random location within 500 feet. Your armor, weapons, and pack are scattered.
You trigger a localized earthquake. Every creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity save or be knocked prone and take 3d6 bludgeoning damage.
A permanent Wall of Fire (as the spell) appears in a 20-foot line starting from your position in a random direction. It lasts for 1 minute without concentration.
You and every creature within 15 feet are banished to a harmless demiplane for 1 round. You all reappear at the start of your next turn.
Your wild magic surges again immediately. Roll twice more on this table and apply both effects simultaneously.

A massive arcane detonation occurs. Every creature within 40 feet takes 6d6 radiant damage. You are at the center and take the full amount. A DC 15 Dexterity save halves the damage for other creatures.
An eye appears on your forehead for the next minute. During that time, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of 1 action have a casting time of 1 bonus action.
You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, after which time you return to the space you previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn. While a plant, you are incapacitated and have vulnerability to all damage. If you drop to 0 hit points, your pot breaks, and your form reverts.
For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
You cast Levitate on yourself.
A unicorn controlled by the DM appears in a space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.
You can't speak for the next minute. Whenever you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth.
You regain all expended sorcery points.
Your size increases by one size category for the next minute.
You cast Polymorph on yourself. If you fail the saving throw, you turn into a sheep for the spell's duration.
A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +2 bonus to AC and immunity to Magic Missile.
You are immune to being intoxicated by alcohol for the next 5d6 days.
For the next minute, you can see any invisible creature if you have line of sight to it.
You regain all expended sorcery points. If you have no sorcery points, you regain one 1st-level spell slot instead.
If you die within the next minute, you immediately come back to life as if by the Reincarnate spell.
You and all creatures within 30 feet of you gain vulnerability to piercing damage for the next minute.
You are surrounded by faint, ethereal music for the next minute.
